name: Minimal Conversation (JS)
description: Minimal JS voice chat for Reachy Mini (HF realtime).

paragraphs: A tiny TypeScript webapp that turns a Reachy Mini robot into a live voice companion powered by the Hugging Face realtime backend - the same speech-to-speech backend the Reachy Mini mobile app uses. No Python backend, no transcript panel, no chat UI. Just one big central circle.

This Space is a reference app for @pollen-robotics/reachy-mini-sdk: the SDK's ./host subpath handles Hugging Face OAuth, the robot picker, and the session lifecycle. This app's code starts from a fully-connected SDK handle and only owns the voice conversation logic.
the browser SDK + the shared shell + iframe bridge (the host is exported under the ./host subpath of the same npm package).
features: The Hugging Face realtime backend (OpenAI-Realtime-compatible JSON
Vite + TypeScript for a zero-config dev server and a static build.

whatItDoes.text: A tiny TypeScript webapp that turns a Reachy Mini robot into a live voice companion powered by the Hugging Face realtime backend - the same speech-to-speech backend the Reachy Mini mobile app uses. No Python backend, no transcript panel, no chat UI. Just one big central circle.

requirements.text: No OpenAI API key needed: the app authorizes the realtime session with your Hugging Face token (see Authentication below).
Click the central circle to sign in.

On first visit the host shell (from @pollen-robotics/reachy-mini-sdk/host) renders the sign-in page and the robot picker; once you select a robot it mounts this app in its iframe with the SDK already connected and the robot awake.
